entries.title: Ecclesiastes 1:1
segments: ¶The words of the Preacher, the son of David, king in Jerusalem.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 1:2
segments: Vanity of vanities, saith the Preacher, vanity of vanities; all [is] vanity.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 1:3
segments: What profit hath a man of all his labour which he taketh under the sun?

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 1:4
segments: ¶[One] generation passeth away, and [another] generation cometh: but the earth abideth for ever.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 1:5
segments: The sun also ariseth, and the sun goeth down, and hasteth to his place where he arose. {hasteth: Heb. panteth}

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 1:6
segments: The wind goeth toward the south, and turneth about unto the north; it whirleth about continually, and the wind returneth again according to his circuits.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 1:7
segments: All the rivers run into the sea; yet the sea [is] not full; unto the place from whence the rivers come, thither they return again. {return...: Heb. return to go}

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 1:8
segments: All things [are] full of labour; man cannot utter [it]: the eye is not satisfied with seeing, nor the ear filled with hearing.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 1:9
segments: ¶The thing that hath been, it [is that] which shall be; and that which is done [is] that which shall be done: and [there is] no new [thing] under the sun.

words.text: ¶The thing that hath been, it [is that] which shall be; and that which is done

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 1:10
segments: Is there [any] thing whereof it may be said, See, this [is] new? it hath been already of old time, which was before us.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 1:11
segments: [There is] no remembrance of former [things]; neither shall there be [any] remembrance of [things] that are to come with [those] that shall come after.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 1:12
segments: ¶I the Preacher was king over Israel in Jerusalem.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 1:13
segments: And I gave my heart to seek and search out by wisdom concerning all [things] that are done under heaven: this sore travail hath God given to the sons of man to be exercised therewith. {to be...: or, to afflict them}

words.text: therewith. {to be...: or, to afflict them}

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 1:14
segments: I have seen all the works that are done under the sun; and, behold, all [is] vanity and vexation of spirit.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 1:15
segments: [That which is] crooked cannot be made straight: and that which is wanting cannot be numbered. {that which is wanting: Heb. defect}

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 1:16
segments: I communed with mine own heart, saying, Lo, I am come to great estate, and have gotten more wisdom than all [they] that have been before me in Jerusalem: yea, my heart had great experience of wisdom and knowledge. {had...: Heb. had seen much}

words.text: , Lo, I am come to great estate
than all [they] that have been before

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 1:17
segments: And I gave my heart to know wisdom, and to know madness and folly: I perceived that this also is vexation of spirit.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 1:18
segments: For in much wisdom [is] much grief: and he that increaseth knowledge increaseth sorrow.
